format: WorkKey.normalize(input) as a client without local files runs it (Swift WorkKey.normalizeRemote) = expect, or null when the input is no work key: no kind before a colon, an empty value, or a value its kind cannot have. The kind (before the first colon) is lowercased. doi: resolver prefixes (http(s)://(dx.)doi.org/, doi.org/, dx.doi.org/, a repeated doi:) dropped, lowercased, trailing . , ; dropped, then a preprint's version dropped: a trailing v and digits that follow a digit, . or / (bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv's DataCite DOIs …v2, preprints.org ….v1, Research Square …/v1), with the . or / it leaves behind, unless nothing would be left after the first slash; a v after a letter is part of the DOI (10.1093/nar/gkv1344, Oxford's 2015 year letter), so it is never dropped; it must start 10. and hold a slash. arxiv: lowercased, an arxiv.org abs or pdf address or an arxiv: label dropped, .pdf and a trailing vN dropped; a modern NNNN.NNNNN or an old-style archive/NNNNNNN id. pmid: digits only (a PMID: label dropped). isbn: hyphens and spaces dropped; an ISBN-10 with a valid check digit (X for 10) becomes the 13 digits with the 978 prefix and a new check digit; an ISBN-13 must have a valid check digit. podcast: <feed>#<episode>, split at the first #: a feed with :// or a dot is a URL normalized by URLNormalizer v1, else a GUID lowercased; the episode is kept exactly. gh: owner/repo lowercased, from a bare pair or a github.com address with or without its http:// or https:// and www., .git and deeper paths dropped. x: the post's digits, bare or from a /status/ address. file: 64 hex characters, lowercased. url: URLNormalizer v1 (url-normalize.json); a local path is no work key off the Mac. Every other kind (yt, zoom, meeting, course, native and kinds a newer client defines) keeps its value exactly, trimmed.
status: Seed set written with WP1; WP2 decided the rules it left open (the podcast feed, gh: letter case, zoom: keys kept exactly) and the refusals, and pinned them here. WP2's review fixed the DOI version rule (a v after a letter is no version) and the gh: address forms.
